title: Rabbi Abba bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Terumot.1.4.3), relating that a pious man asked Elijah whether someone naked may recite the Shema. Hyman cites Bava Metzia 114a for a version in which Rabbah bar Nachmani asks this question.[^2] [Bereshit Rabbah 33:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.33.3) also mentions him together with Rabbi Tanchuma, both speaking in the name of Rabbi Acha.[^1]

notes.text: In the Yerushalmi, Abba bar Avin narrates the episode and an unnamed pious man asks Elijah. In the consulted passage at [Bava Metzia 114a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.114a.10), Rabbah bar Avuha asks Elijah about a debtor. Bereshit Rabbah calls the cited teacher Rav Acha.

The Bavli dialogue carries into [Bava Metzia 114b:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.114b.1). In that passage Rabbah bar Avuha asks Elijah about a person separating terumah while naked. The linked Yerushalmi instead has an unnamed pious man ask about reciting the Shema.
